example.title: Junior Seau Pier Amphitheatre bandshell, Oceanside (c. 1990)

brief: A beachfront bandshell below the pier: a low white concrete stage house with a flat roof and a shallow proscenium opening facing a wide paved arena and terraced red-painted seating, palms and the beach beyond. Three photos. Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).
label: Bandshell
